# Drawn signature maker

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/signature-maker/

Draw a signature using a mouse, pen or touch input, undo strokes and export a transparent image for your own document workflow.

## How to use it

1. Choose your image or enter your own text.
2. Pick a layout, style or output size.
3. Create the result and download your shareable image.

## Example

Draw your name in dark ink and download a transparent PNG with tight cropping.

## Limits and checks

This creates a drawn signature image, not a certificate-backed digital signature. Check the recipient’s acceptance requirements and use only signatures you are authorized to use.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
